name: Ana Clara Ebert
bio: Research Master's student in Social Psychology at VU Amsterdam, interested in the social and psychological mechanisms that maintain socioeconomic inequality.

name: Jasmin Hagemann
bio: Researcher in political psychology who completed a Research Master in Psychology at the University of Amsterdam. Her work focuses on political behavior, polarization, and democratic resilience.

name: Lukas Wallrich
bio: Senior Lecturer in Organisational Psychology at Birkbeck Business School, University of London. His research focuses on workforce diversity and organizational performance, and improving statistical and methodological practices.

name: Max Wan
bio: Data analyst and interdisciplinary researcher.

name: Flavio Azevedo
bio: Brazilian assistant professor of Interdisciplinary Social Sciences at Utrecht University. His research focuses on the political psychology of ideological attitudes and integrating open science practices.

name: Andre Kaiser
bio: Professor of Comparative Politics at University of Cologne and Director of Cologne Center for Comparative Politics.

name: Ben Saunders
bio: Associate Professor at Long Island University, Brooklyn. Research interests include social identity, stereotype threat, and system justification theory.

name: Christopher S. Parker
bio: Professor of Political Science at the University of Washington, author of 'Fighting for Democracy' and 'Change They Can't Believe In'.

name: Joshua Tybur
bio: Associate Professor in Experimental and Applied Psychology at VU Amsterdam, studying fundamental problems of life including disease avoidance, mating, and interdependence.

name: Patrick Forscher
bio: Post-doc researcher at the Co-Regulation (CORE) Lab focusing on meta-science and social disparities.

name: Tobias Rothmund
bio: Professor at the Institute for Communication Science at Friedrich Schiller University, investigating psychological processes in media-mediated communication.

name: Iris Smal
bio: PhD candidate researching how opinions and attitudes form and change using complex systems models. Also Open Science Community Manager for OSCA.

name: Gabriel Gaudencio
affiliation: Universidade Presbiteriana Mackenzie, São Paulo, Brazil
bio: Clinical psychologist and neuroscientist specializing in moral decision-making, brain stimulation, and social neuroscience.

name: Felipe Vilanova
bio: Social/political psychologist researching right-wing authoritarianism, corruption, ideology, and political attitudes. ISPP Governing Council member (2025-2028).

name: Roosevelt Vilar
affiliation: Universidade Cruzeiro do Sul, São Paulo, Brazil
bio: Researcher focused on human values, political behavior, political participation, and cross-cultural psychology. PhD from Massey University (NZ).

name: Leticia Micheli
bio: Postdoctoral fellow at the Institute of Psychology, Leibniz University Hannover, researching how inequality, scarcity and unfairness influence decision-making.

name: Tamara Marques
bio: Research assistant doing a masters in Sociology at University of Minho, Portugal, interested in Black Lives Matter, race & ethnicity, and social movements.

name: Gijs Schumacher
bio: Professor of Political Psychology researching how emotions influence democracy and political decision-making. Co-director of the Hot Politics Lab at UvA.

name: Joe Vitriol
bio: Assistant Professor at Lehigh University, College of Business. Studies causes, consequences, and solutions to bias in judgment and behavior in political, legal, and organizational settings.

name: Gaëlle Marinthe
bio: Associate Professor specializing in identity processes, collective action, and intergroup relations. Research on collective narcissism and political extremism.

name: Han van der Maas
bio: Professor of Psychological Methods specializing in formalization and testing of psychological theories in cognition, attitudes, and intelligence. ERC grant recipient.

name: Birol Akkus
bio: Assistant Professor researching the influence of culture and cultural values on adolescent/youth development, mental wellbeing, and risk behavior.

name: Meta van der Linden
bio: Assistant Professor researching social psychology of immigration and refugee integration, examining inclusion/exclusion of migrants through an interdisciplinary lens.

name: Tobias Stark
bio: Associate Professor specializing in ethnic prejudice, national identities, and interethnic relations. ERC Consolidator Grant recipient (€2M).

name: Robert Ross
bio: Research Fellow researching psychology of belief — religious belief, delusional belief, and misinformation. Combines meta-science with cognitive psychology.

name: Quinnehtukqut McLamore
bio: Assistant Professor in Psychological Sciences studying conflict narratives, group identities, conspiracy theories, and dehumanization.

name: Verena Seibel
bio: Assistant Professor with tenure researching migration and social integration, examining how migrants access welfare services. ERC Starting Grant recipient (2025).
